tenderSchedule.title: Transportation of Coal from ECL to YTPS
tenderSchedule.description: APPOINTMENT OF COAL TRANSPORTATION AGENCY FOR LIAISONING, SUPERVISION OF LOADING, MOVEMENT & HANDLING AND DELIVERY OF RAW COAL ALONG WITH QUALITY AND QUANTITY ASSURANCE FROM THE MINES OF EASTERN COALFIELDS LIMITED (ECL) / RAILWAY LOADING POINTS OF ECL TO YERMARUS THERMAL POWER STATION (YTPS) BY ALL RAIL ROUTE
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Chief Engineer Mines office Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: No. 82, Shakthi Bhavan, Race Course Road

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions are as per the tender document
Bidders are requested to quote only their Basic rates (exclusive of GST) in Rs. per MT for each item of the Price Schedule.
Appropriate GST component shall be indicated by the bidder at appropriate place in KPPP for all items of the Price Schedule
Please refer Clause 25.0 (Section-3) of the tender document about the Evaluation of bids
Bidder shall upload/furnish genuine documents. If any of the documents/affidavits found false/incorrect, their bid is liable to be rejected and action will be initiated as per the extant terms.
Bidders shall peruse the tender document carefully and upload all required documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer shall be an established Coal Transportation Agency and shall have satisfactorily executed as prime contractor, similar works involving Liaisoning, Supervision of Coal Loading, Handling, Monitoring of Coal Rake Movement and Delivery of raw coal from the loading points of Eastern Coalfields Limited (ECL) to any Thermal Power Station / Industrial Units in India through an All-Rail-Route (ARR), handling at least a minimum quantity of 2.50 Lakh MT of Coal and contract value of not less than Rs. 4.15 Crore, in any one financial year during the preceding five financial years ie., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. In proof of the above, the Tenderer shall submit Performance Certificate / Work Completion Certificate (as per proforma provided in the tender document at Annexure -VII in the letter head of the issuing Company/Authority) issued by General Manager / Chief Engineer / Head of the Company or Industrial Unit, along with relevant work order copies

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work done certificate along with relevant work orders/ contract agreements

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall have achieved a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 16.58 Crore in at least two financial years during the preceding five financial years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. In support of the above, the tenderer shall submit a Turnover Certificate along with copies of the audited Profit and Loss Statements and Balance Sheets for the relevant financial years, duly certified by the Chartered Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Profit and loss statements and audited balance sheets duly certified by the Chartered Accountants

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall be financially sound and capable of executing high value contracts. As a proof of their financial capability, they shall submit a firm and unconditional Letter of Commitment for an amount of Rs. 2.08 crore (Rupees Two Crore Eight Lakh only), issued by a Nationalised Bank / Scheduled Bank/ or a branch of a Foreign Banks operating in India valid for a minimum period of one year to meet the financial requirements of the contract. In proof of the above, the Tenderer shall submit Letter of Commitment (as per the format prescribed at Annexure II) of the tender document, issued by bankers.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Letter of commitment from the bank as per the proforma provided in the tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All documents required under PQR and other conditions of the tender

itemList.itemName: Service charge - for supervision of loading of Coal and monitoring the movement of Coal rakes
Service charge - for liaisoning with Coal company and Railways.
